title: The layout knows docs/health, so the scorecard file does not fail Layout
why: Finding, Oct 27 (o4 scorecard lane, debt health-folder-not-in-layout, PR #709): lint/layout.json has no kind for docs/health, where the new scorecard file goes, so in a rolled-out repo Layout scores out because of the scorecard itself.
note: Green and reviewed, draft PR #728 (head 87645bb1), waits for the next batch: kind scorecard (docs/health/compliance.md) in lint/layout.json, the scorecard reads it, debt closed. Was: add a health kind for docs/health/ to lint/layout.json (the one home, o2), point the scorecard writer at it, and close the debt; red first on a repo whose only finding is docs/health/. Blocks r1 (run compliance-check on each child repo). Needs no answer. Port: yes, at each repo's roll-out through the layout. Placed ahead of c107 (triage, Oct 27): small, and r1 cannot start without it.
